name: InterContinental Paris - Le Grand
description:
InterContinental Paris - Le Grand is an IHG InterContinental property in central Paris, inaugurated by Empress Eugenie in 1862 and looking directly across to the Palais Garnier opera house.
Facilities include parking, room service, and the recently restored Salon Opera ballroom.
Dining is led by Cafe de la Paix, a historic Parisian institution, and La Verriere in a winter garden setting.

images.description: A luxurious hotel suite is depicted, featuring a king-sized bed with soft pink linens and decorative pillows. To the left, a cozy seating area includes two upholstered armchairs and a small round table with a vase of fresh flowers. Large windows and a glass door open to a balcony, offering a stunning, unobstructed view of the Eiffel Tower and the classic Parisian cityscape.

This image showcases a luxurious hotel suite, featuring a large bed with an upholstered headboard and soft pink decorative pillows. To the right, a comfortable seating area with a sofa and a small dark wood table with a vase of fresh flowers is visible. The room is elegantly decorated in a palette of creams, greys, and soft pinks, with mirrored accents and a patterned carpet. A window with light-colored drapes is visible on the right side, allowing natural light into the space.

To the right, a dark wood vanity with a black marble countertop and gold accents holds two sinks and a large framed mirror. A wide window, flanked by rich red and gold patterned curtains, opens to a balcony and offers a stunning view of an ornate building with multiple green domes and classical architecture.

A luxurious and elegantly furnished suite features a spacious living area and a separate dining space, both adorned with classic, opulent decor. The living area includes a large beige sofa, red armchairs, and a glass coffee table, all set on a rich red patterned rug, under ornate chandeliers. Large windows with red and patterned drapes offer a glimpse of city buildings outside. The adjacent dining area is furnished with a dark wood table, red chairs, and a modern red artwork.

This image showcases a luxurious and elegantly furnished hotel suite living room. The room features classic decor with a plush sofa, armchairs, a glass coffee table, and two dark green velvet ottomans, all set on a patterned rug. Rich green velvet curtains frame tall windows, allowing natural light to illuminate the space, which is further enhanced by a grand crystal chandelier and ornate table lamps. Various artworks adorn the walls, contributing to the sophisticated ambiance.

A glass coffee table is adorned with a vase of white flowers and green foliage, while a black and gold console table holds a modern sculpture. A luxurious hotel guest room is depicted, featuring a large bed with crisp white linens and blue decorative pillows. A dark wood desk and chair are positioned against the blue wall, while a blue armchair and floor lamp are placed near a window. Two vibrant yellow velvet pillows, each embroidered with an 'H' emblem, accent the bed. Mirrored panels above the headboard reflect the room's warm lighting from two ornate bedside lamps, while a window with sheer white and solid yellow curtains is visible on the right.

This image showcases a luxurious hotel suite, featuring a spacious bedroom area with a large bed and an adjacent living space with a sofa, armchair, and coffee table. The room is adorned with sophisticated furnishings, including crystal lamps, fresh white flowers, and a large framed black and white artwork.

The decor is predominantly in light, neutral tones, creating a bright and elegant ambiance. A hallway with an open doorway is visible in the background, suggesting further spaciousness.

This image showcases a lavish hotel suite living room, adorned with classic French-inspired decor. The spacious room features two beige sofas with red patterned cushions, a large glass-top coffee table, and a separate seating area with red velvet chairs and a dark wood desk. Ornate details include a gold chandelier, decorative wall moldings, and windows draped with rich red and gold curtains, offering a glimpse of an elegant urban building exterior.

A large window offers a stunning view of a grand architectural dome, likely the Opéra Garnier, adding to the luxurious ambiance of the space.
